hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Africa, east of Angola, south of the Democratic Republic of the Congo || mostly high plateau with some hills and mountains || landlocked; the Zambezi forms a natural river boundary with Zimbabwe; Lake Kariba on the Zambia-Zimbabwe border forms the world's largest reservoir by volume (180 cu km; 43 cu mi) || Resources: copper, cobalt, zinc, lead, coal, emeralds, gold, silver, uranium, hydropower || Exports: raw copper, refined copper, gold, precious stones, electricity (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly high plateau with some hills and mountains || Southern Africa, east of Angola, south of the Democratic Republic of the Congo

climate.excerpt: tropical; modified by altitude; rainy season (October to April) || periodic drought; tropical storms (November to April)

economy.excerpt: lower-middle-income sub-Saharan economy; regional hydroelectricity producer; trade ties and infrastructure investments from China; IMF assistance to restructure debt burden; one of youngest and fastest-growing labor forces; systemic corruption; extreme rural poverty || Exports: raw copper, refined copper, gold, precious stones, electricity (2023) || Industries: copper mining and processing, emerald mining, construction, foodstuffs, beverages, chemicals, textiles, fertilizer, horticulture
